name: Valid login
goal: Log in with username 'standard_user' and password 'secret_sauce'.
expected: User lands on the Products inventory page showing a list of products.

name: Invalid login shows error
goal: Try to log in with username 'standard_user' and password 'wrong_password'.
expected: Login is rejected and an error message about username/password not matching is displayed. User stays on the login page.

name: Add to cart and verify
goal: Log in as 'standard_user' / 'secret_sauce', add the 'Sauce Labs Backpack' to the cart, then open the cart.
expected: The cart page lists exactly one item, 'Sauce Labs Backpack'.

name: Full checkout
goal: Log in as 'standard_user' / 'secret_sauce', add any one product to the cart, and complete checkout using name 'Test User' and postal code '12345', finishing the order.
expected: The order completes and a 'Thank you for your order' confirmation is shown.
